verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents exporting financial statements on a cash or accrual basis in Excel, CSV and PDF, and one-click real-time reports. Its MCP guide shows asking for an income statement "this quarter", and reconciliation is presented as the basis for confidence in the reports. However, the evidence never names the balance sheet or cash-flow statement specifically, and never documents choosing an arbitrary reporting period. missing for 10: explicit balance sheet and cash-flow statement documentation, documented custom/any-period date selection, independent or hands-on corroboration of statement accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand

citations.quote: you can export a full general ledger and financial statements on either cash or accrual basis in excel, csv, and pdf formats.
Get real-time financial reports with one click
Try asking things like 'What does my income statement look like this quarter?'
giving you 100% confidence in your financial reports.
